arms.as_continuous: per lambda: J's recorded per-candidate schedule with every (Delta, alpha) replaced by (Delta, continuous), replayed on the hybrid trunk without policy calls; a candidate whose J endpoint is a typed failure keeps the failure
arms.controls: no-model action prior (Gate-B rule, fit-verdicts.json) in every table; wrong-anchor control (480 fit anchors x grid candidates) of J-1e-04, Jcont-1e-04, CJ-1e-04
arms.restricted_policy: #101 J (pe, lambda 1e-04); argmax over the allowed subset of the same logits (request_selectors.restricted_spec), no retraining

caps.scope_rule: if the projected elapsed wall exceeds 24 h on 2 GPUs, cut to the acceptance minimum (5 lambdas per family) and record why on #114

claim_boundary: one look at the sealed #109 evaluation split for policies trained on the #109 policy split; grid ranking primary, other inventories descriptive; tie-free cost; DESCRIPTIVE intervals; MACs are linear MACs, wall times are RTX 5090 GPU seconds; no closed-loop claim

decision_rule.primary: claim 'adaptive alpha adds decision value beyond adaptive Delta at matched compute': J - J-cont paired grid AUC per (level, seed), each frontier interpolated piecewise linearly in log10 mean MACs per candidate (every lambda point, sorted by MACs, no outcome-based pruning, no extrapolation) at two budgets: the MACs of J's and of C-J's lambda = 1e-4 points. Per budget the delta rule: supported iff mean >= 0.02 and lower > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff upper < 0.02; else readiness_or_precision_insufficient. A budget above a frontier's largest MACs uses that frontier's largest-MAC point (the policy cannot spend more; flagged); a budget below its smallest MACs gives readiness_or_precision_insufficient (no extrapolation). Disposition: supported iff supported at both budgets; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff not supported at either; else readiness_or_precision_insufficient; any failed guard -> readiness_or_precision_insufficient
decision_rule.secondary: J - C-J at the same budgets with the same rule (does the hybrid keep its advantage over the horizon-only adaptive baseline at matched compute?); at lambda = 1e-4 (unmatched): J - J-cont, J - T-cont, J - C-J, J - J-as-cont, J - T-micro/macro, J - D-1/5/15, J-cont - T-cont and each policy - prior, every inventory, same token rule; offset, angle, power DESCRIPTIVE

disclosure: Known before the freeze: Gate B (unit 0.7444, C* 0.7834, prior 0.7203 on grid), the #101 results (J at lambdas 1e-5..1e-2 on this split: grid AUC 0.704/0.706/0.734/0.713 at 181M/184M/34M/50M MACs; F-15-continuous 0.762, F-1-continuous 0.677) and every #96/#100/#112 result. No J-cont or C-J policy and no restricted-argmax arm has been scored on an evaluation capture. Hardware: RTX 5090 instead of the #85 RTX 3090.

evaluation.split: the #109 evaluation split as in Gate B (stream issue109-evaluation, mixed cells)

guards.G1_isolation: pool = policy roster, disjoint from fit and evaluation rosters
guards.G3_chronology: frozen_at <= first training <= last training <= first score
guards.G4_checkpoint_binding: every scored policy's sha256 equals its training report (#101 for reused J)
guards.G5_replication_101_gate_b: fixed and reused-J rows (and schedules) equal the #101 records; F-15-macro and C-F-15 equal the Gate-B unit and C* records
guards.G6_restricted_schedules: restricted and J-cont schedules use only their allowed requests
guards.failure: a failed guard turns the dispositions into readiness_or_precision_insufficient

metrics.auc: tie-free cost, m99.view; per (level, seed); member-clustered bootstrap 10000 draws PCG64 7201
metrics.decomposition: first - second = (a) (n1 - n2) c2 [calls, horizon] + (b) n1 (c1 - c2) [per-call; for C-J split into alpha n1 (c1 - c_cont,hybrid) and trunk n1 (c_cont,hybrid - c2)] + (c) p1 m1 - p2 m2 [policy]; n calls, c mean predictor MACs per call, p policy calls, m policy MACs per call
metrics.macs: linear MACs per candidate rollout (predictor calls x per-call MACs + policy calls x policy MACs)
metrics.ties: all-tied cells and tied success-failure pairs per arm
metrics.top3: hit iff a success is among the three lowest-cost admissible candidates (cost, ordinal)
metrics.wall: CUDA-synchronized GPU seconds per state (per cell rollout of all candidates)

CJ.labels: #77 prediction-error DP on the C* predictor
CJ.name: C-J (horizon-only adaptive on the LC continuous C* predictor)

J.labels: #77 prediction-error DP (request_policy.window_rows) with lambda as the compute weight
J.name: J (all nine requests, hybrid trunk)

Jcont.labels: request_selectors.restricted_window_rows: the same DP and DAgger contexts over R_cont only; the work term counts the full policy
Jcont.name: J-cont (R_cont on the hybrid trunk, six logits masked)
Jcont.policy: request_selectors.MaskedRequestPolicy: the 242 -> 128 -> 9 policy, logits outside R_cont = -inf (same parameters and initialization as J)

policies.lambda_grid_reason: 8 values from 1e-5 to 1e-1 (>= 5 required) including the ICLR 1e-4 and the four #101 J values; the ICLR operating points (#74: hybrid 118.7M, continuous_adaptive 356.0M MACs per candidate and state, both at lambda 1e-4) are reproduced by recipe at 1e-4. Smoke label mixes on policy units (training data; probes 0, 1e-6, 0.3, 1, 10): below 1e-5 the labels equal 1e-5's (the DP is error-dominated) and above 1e-1 they saturate (Delta = 15 wherever the window allows), so the grid spans each policy's reachable MAC range; resolution is densest where J's labels change (1e-4 .. 1e-1)

pool.source: the #101 pool (issue-101 data/pool.pt): #109 policy split, 120 levels, 3480 shots, first 60-frame window per shot; unit = policy level

predictors.continuous: LC continuous fold 'all' Gate-B C* checkpoints (C-J, C-F-*)
predictors.hybrid: LC hybrid fold 'all' Gate-B unit checkpoints (J, J-cont, restricted arms, J-as-cont)
predictors.pairing: policy seed s uses predictor seed s
